command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./data -prune -o -type f -print | head -50; ls -la data | head -30; cat docs/overview.md
cd /app/docs; cat election.md records.md counting.md output.md changelog.md

cd /app; cat tests/test_tally.py | head -60; ls data/cvr | head; ls data/cvr | wc -l; head -c 1500 data/cvr/$(ls data/cvr | grep csv | head -1); head -c 800 data/cvr/$(ls data/cvr | grep jsonl | head -1); head -c 1500 data/election.json; cat tools/check_tally.py | head -40
cd /app; mkdir -p out; python3 bin/tally.py data out/tally.json && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -15; python tools/check_tally.py

cd /app; echo '{"status": "success", "summary": "Wrote /app/bin/tally.py following the documented rules (batch revisions, write-ins, ranking reading, rounds, tie-breaks) and generated /app/out/tally.json. Unit tests pass and check_tally.py reports all 7 contests and 31 rounds matching."}' > STATUS.json; cat STATUS.json
